isomorphisms.name: Spirit as Hamiltonian/Noether Generator
isomorphisms.domain_b: Physics: Hamiltonian (H) as generator of time evolution; Noether's theorem as generator of conserved charges
isomorphisms.chi_law: E ↔ H ↔ Noether's theorem: the operation that produces, not a product; generator is not a state variable but the function defined on phase space that governs evolution
isomorphisms.physics_process: Hamiltonian mechanics: H generates time evolution via Hamilton's equations; Noether's theorem: symmetries generate conserved charges via a generating functional
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Spirit (E) as the generator of spiritual families (Gifts), not a state variable; the Actualizer that produces all other rows
isomorphisms.prediction: Individual Gifts of the Spirit will map to specific generators in the Lie algebra of Sp(10,R)
physics_process_steps: Hamiltonian H is defined on phase space, not in it
H generates time evolution via dq/dt = ∂H/∂p, dp/dt = -∂H/∂q
Noether's theorem reads symmetries and outputs conserved charges
State-level methods (equilibrium analysis) fail to derive H because H is not a state variable
The generator inventory (e.g., symmetries) are operation-typed capacities
mapped_text_steps: E (Spirit) is the generator layer, not a state variable
E maps to H as generator of time evolution
E maps to Noether's theorem as generator of all charges
State-level methods failed to derive E because E is not a state variable
Gifts of the Spirit are operation-typed capacities (generator inventory)
preserved_transitions: State-level methods fail on generator → generator is not a state variable (preserved in both domains)
Generator produces charges → Spirit produces spiritual families (preserved)
Generator is operation-typed → Spirit is operation-typed (preserved)
missing_transitions: Detailed mapping of each Gift to a specific generator in Sp(10,R) is not yet provided
isomorphisms.notes: The mapping is exceptionally tight: the categorical distinction between generator and generated is identical in both domains. The only missing piece is the detailed Gift-to-generator assignments, which is acknowledged as pending.

isomorphisms.name: Spirit as Relation in Trinity
isomorphisms.domain_a: Theophysics: Spirit as Relation between Father (A) and Son (C)
isomorphisms.domain_b: Physics: Hamiltonian as the operation that connects symmetries to charges (Noether's theorem)
isomorphisms.chi_law: Spirit is to Trinity what Hamiltonian is to phase space: the thing that makes everything else move; both are operation-typed, not object-typed
isomorphisms.physics_process: Hamiltonian generates dynamics; Noether's theorem generates charges from symmetries
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Spirit as the bond (Relation) between Father and Son; the Actualizer
physics_process_steps: Hamiltonian is the generator of time evolution
Noether's theorem is the operation connecting symmetries to charges
mapped_text_steps: Spirit is Relation in the Trinity (operation-typed)
missing_transitions: The specific relational structure of the Trinity (Father-Son-Spirit) does not have a direct parallel in the Hamiltonian/Noether relation; the mapping is at the level of 'operation-typed' rather than a detailed relational algebra
isomorphisms.notes: The mapping is suggestive but less detailed than iso_1. The Trinity's internal relational dynamics are not fully mirrored in the physics of generators.

isomorphisms.name: Gifts of the Spirit as Generator Inventory
isomorphisms.domain_a: Theophysics: Gifts of the Spirit (wisdom, understanding, etc.) as capacities to act
isomorphisms.domain_b: Physics: Generator algebra of Sp(10,R) — the set of all generators that produce conserved charges
isomorphisms.chi_law: Each Gift is an operation (capacity), not a state; the set of Gifts is the inventory of generators
isomorphisms.physics_process: Lie algebra generators are operation-typed; they generate symmetries and conserved quantities
isomorphisms.theological_phenomenon: Gifts of the Spirit are operation-typed capacities; they are the 'generator inventory' of the Spirit
isomorphisms.prediction: Each Gift will map to a specific generator in Sp(10,R)
physics_process_steps: Generators in a Lie algebra are operation-typed
Each generator produces a specific symmetry/charge
mapped_text_steps: Each Gift is a specific capacity (e.g., wisdom, healing)
missing_transitions: No individual Gift-to-generator assignments are provided; the mapping is at the level of category (operation-typed) rather than specific correspondence
isomorphisms.notes: The mapping is promising but lacks detail. The claim that each Gift corresponds to a specific generator in Sp(10,R) is a strong prediction that has not yet been verified.
